goal: Derive a coherent Alice-owned backbone hypothesis from comic commitments and research, then specify a narrow FloRA test without changing the pending run.
procedure: Audit comic requirements, current source and external mechanisms in parallel. Distinguish a coherent logical design from incomplete semantic composition. Propose one semantic commit authority with separate typed roles and decision episodes linked to goal-specific consequences. Review stale-query coverage, atomic publication, permission races, mixed host/self revisions and privileged-annotation confounds. Record strong equal-information controls before any successor implementation.
authority: Owner explicitly reopened architecture and requested research plus a proposed hypothesis. Existing canonical runtime and pending experiment remain unchanged; replacement and full Alice ratification are not claimed.
validation: Pinned source and primary papers/code reviewed; three parallel audits reconciled and draft reviewed for material omissions. Existing trace validator checks corpus shape. No experiment or benchmark reproduced and no provider status refreshed.
failure_or_lesson: A backend failure before the test cannot diagnose the cognitive hypothesis. A coherent commit boundary improves consistency but does not supply semantic learning. Goal-specific mixed outcomes require separate host and assistant-self revisions. Stale retrieval omissions require coverage checks; link ablations need equal-information controls and no evaluator-provided causal answers.
